filing_office: Washington Secretary of State, Corporations and Charities Division
filing_fee_notes: Base paper formation fee is 180; online filing adds a processing fee whose amount was not confirmed. An initial report filed separately costs 10; it is free when included with formation.
registered_agent_rules: Maintain a consenting registered agent with a physical Washington street address. A post office box or private mailbox does not qualify as the registered office.
expedite_options: An additional 100 provides expedited processing, generally within three working days.
annual_report_due: Last day of the formation anniversary month. A separate initial report is required within 120 days of formation.
plain_english_summary: The base formation fee is 180 and the annual report costs 70. Complete the initial report within 120 days.
common_mistake: The initial report and annual report have different deadlines.
notes: Ordinary domestic LLC. Filing URLs are official gateways. The unemployment URL is the Revenue Department's official employer-registration guidance identifying Employment Security. Name-search URL, standard formation processing time, franchise or privilege tax, publication requirement and operating-agreement mandate were not confirmed.
